thread.title: Canadian Media Struggle to Digest PM Carney's Chummy Meeting with Trump
thread.title_full: Canadian Media Struggle to Digest PM Carney's Chummy Meeting with Trump

author: MrToad21
text:
What were Canadian voter expectations? Carney to go in there, read Trump the riot act and come home with $200 billion and defense concessions? What happened is what everyone outside of Canada thought was going to happen. Carney went into the White House and got smashed with the sledgehammer of reality by the Bad Orange Man and the Greedy Yankees.
I think Carney and Pierre, The Conservative both realize that Trump and the greedy Yankees mean business this time around. Forget Canada, the Bad Orange Man has got communist China looking to bend the knee and he's not even four months into this term.
The best move would be for Canada to actually be the "friend, partner and ally" of the United States instead of paying lip service to American voters. Lose the tariffs on US goods and meet that NATO pledge. I bet things will start going Canada's way sooner rather than later. Quit fighting and/or exploiting the Americans, it would be in your best interest.
